newsitem.title: POLAND: Kredyt offers PLN 100 mln 3-mth CDs.
newsitem.headline: Kredyt offers PLN 100 mln 3-mth CDs.

text.p: Poland's Kredyt Bank offered to sell 100 million zlotys of 19-percent three-month CDs to the non-banking sector clients on November 7, 1996, a dealer at the bank said on Monday.
Pawel Mielnicki told Reuters the paper, due on February 12, 1997 and with a face value of 100,000 zlotys each, can be sold with the premium or at a discount.
He said any unsold portion of the tranche would later be available at a issue price, which is to be set after the tender's value date on November 12, 1996. @
At its last auction on October 4, Kredyt Bank sold nearly 27 million zlotys worth of CDs at the average price of 99.98.
The issue price was set at par.

On Monday, three-month interbank deposits were quoted at 19.25/19.85 percent, T-bills with three months to maturity were at 18.68/18.58 percent against a maximum yield of 18.60 percent for the 13-week T-bill at last week's primary tender.
